result.summary: The app interface is mostly well-structured, but there is a layout issue regarding the visibility of the restaurant card at the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The restaurant card partially visible at the bottom of the screen lacks descriptive text, pricing, and restaurant identification, appearing incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the card height or scrolling bounds to ensure at least a partial display of the primary metadata, or ensure the layout snap points prevent cards from being cut off in an uninformative state.
